title: Base change of a presentation
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $n,m\ge0$, $f_1,\dots,f_m\in R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], and $\pi:R[x_1,\dots,x_n]\to A$ a surjective $R$-algebra homomorphism whose kernel is the ideal $(f_1,\dots,f_m)$ (a presentation of $A$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]). Let $R\to R'$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $\kappa:R[x_1,\dots,x_n]\to R'[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ the ring homomorphism applying $R\to R'$ to the coefficients ($x_i\mapsto x_i$), and $f'_j=\kappa(f_j)$. Let $A'=A\otimes_RR'$, an $R'$-algebra via $r'\mapsto1\otimes r'$. Then the $R'$-algebra homomorphism $\pi':R'[x_1,\dots,x_n]\to A'$ with $\pi'(x_i)=\pi(x_i)\otimes1$ is surjective and its kernel is the ideal $(f'_1,\dots,f'_m)$; that is, $A'=R'[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f'_1,\dots,f'_m)$ is a presentation of $A'$ over $R'$.

source.place: Commutative Algebra, Section 05G3 (section-base-change), remark after Definition 05G4, line 2420-2425 ('If S = R[x_i]/(f_j) ... then S ⊗_R R' = R'[x_i]/(f'_j)'); used in the proof of Smoothing Lemma 07CC (smoothing.tex line 305)

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: for P : Algebra.Presentation R A (Fin n) (Fin m) with relations f_j, P.baseChange R' : Algebra.Presentation R' (R' ⊗[R] A) (Fin n) (Fin m) has generators x_i ↦ 1 ⊗ₜ P.val x_i (Algebra.Generators.baseChange, Generators.lean:258, simps lemma baseChange_val), relations MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R R') f_j (baseChange_relation), and the field span_range_relation_eq_ker (Basic.lean:62) says these relations span the kernel of the surjection aeval (val) : R'[x] → R' ⊗[R] A. The node's A ⊗_R R' is R' ⊗_R A after the swap a ⊗ r' ↦ r' ⊗ a (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm, Mathlib/RingTheory/TensorProduct/Maps.lean:380), which is R'-linear for the R'-structures on the two sides and sends π(x_i) ⊗ 1 to 1 ⊗ π(x_i).
